introHtml: Unisex bag clips are a practical promotional item that appeals to any audience. Whether you are handing them out at a trade show or including them in a corporate gift bag, these clips keep snacks fresh and organized. Made from durable plastic with a strong spring, they can be imprinted with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving. Choose from a range of colors to match your brand.
